desc_en: IQ tax - money wasted being gullible

sequence.py: Nǐ jiāoguo zhì shāng shuì ma?
sequence.en: Have you ever paid the "IQ tax"?

sequence.cn: 智商税，不是真的税，是你多花的冤枉钱。
sequence.py: Zhì shāng shuì, bú shì zhēn de shuì, shì nǐ duō huā de yuānwang qián.
sequence.en: 智商税 isn't a real tax — it's the extra money you wasted.

sequence.cn: 东西不值那个价，你还是买了，这就是给智商交税。
sequence.py: Dōngxi bù zhí nàge jià, nǐ háishi mǎi le, zhè jiù shì gěi zhìshāng jiāo shuì.
sequence.en: The thing isn't worth the price, but you bought it anyway — that's paying tax on your own IQ.

sequence.cn: 小美买了一个"睡眠神器"，花了两千块。
sequence.py: Xiǎo Měi mǎi le yí ge "shuìmián shénqì", huā le liǎng qiān kuài.
sequence.en: Xiao Mei bought a "magic sleep gadget" for two thousand yuan.

sequence.cn: 广告说，戴上它，三分钟就能睡着。
sequence.py: Guǎnggào shuō, dài shàng tā, sān fēnzhōng jiù néng shuìzháo.
sequence.en: The ad said: put it on and you'll fall asleep in three minutes.

sequence.cn: 结果她戴上以后，越戴越精神。
sequence.py: Jiéguǒ tā dài shàng yǐhòu, yuè dài yuè jīngshen.
sequence.en: But after she put it on, the longer she wore it the wider awake she got.

sequence.cn: 小美很生气，决定把它挂到网上卖掉。
sequence.py: Xiǎo Měi hěn shēngqì, juédìng bǎ tā guà dào wǎngshàng mài diào.
sequence.en: Xiao Mei was furious and decided to list it online and sell it off.

sequence.cn: 没想到，真的有人花两千块买走了。
sequence.py: Méi xiǎngdào, zhēn de yǒu rén huā liǎng qiān kuài mǎi zǒu le.
sequence.en: To her surprise, someone really did pay two thousand and take it away.

sequence.cn: 小美笑了：原来智商税，是可以转手的。
sequence.py: Xiǎo Měi xiào le: yuánlái zhì shāng shuì, shì kěyǐ zhuǎnshǒu de.
sequence.en: Xiao Mei smiled: turns out the IQ tax can be passed on to someone else.
